event.name: Indonesia Earthquake 2026
event.summary: A magnitude 7.8 earthquake struck 64 km north-northwest of Ende, Flores, at 05:58 on 15 August 2026 local time, followed by an intense aftershock sequence along the north coast from Labuan Bajo to Ende, including an M6.1 within half an hour. At least 69 people were killed. Mapping is coordinated by HOT's Open Mapping Hub Asia-Pacific with the Indonesian community, on the Tasking Manager and MapSwipe.
